headline: The large six-dispute scenario is mostly derivable, but liability amounts, the PIN status after a reported skimming, and the purchase type of the late fraud charge each have more than one defensible answer.

issues.summary: Four non-fraud disputes noticed 11/07-11/09 and reported 11/14 (5 business days later) store liability 50. Counting from when the customer noticed, doc_031 gives the $500 tier.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031: "inform the customer of their liability exposure based on when they noticed the unauthorized activity: - Reported within 2 business days of statement: Maximum liability $50 - Reported within 60 days of statement: Maximum liability $500"

tools.py file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281 docstring: "customer_max_liability_amount (number): The maximum dollar amount the customer could be liable for based on Regulation E reporting timing rules and the disputed amount. Use -1 for unlimited liability."
No statement dates exist in the DB or the documents; get_now() = 2025-11-14 (Friday)
gold[11] ATM discovery 11/07/2025, gold[12] discovery 11/09/2025, gold[14] discovery 11/09/2025, gold[16] discovery 11/08/2025 -> 5 business days each; all liability 50
issues.why_it_matters: An agent applying the discovery-based tier, or treating Reg E tiers as unauthorized-only (0 for errors), stores different values and fails debit_card_disputes.
issues.suggested_fix: State one deterministic rule in doc_031, for example: liability tier is counted from the discovery date to today in business days, applies to every dispute category, and is capped at the disputed amount. Then regenerate customer_max_liability_amount in every gold dispute.

issues.summary: For TechWorld the customer says "I think someone skimmed my card", which fits pin_compromised 'yes_observed' ("believes PIN was observed/skimmed"). The gold stores 'unknown'. The gold also stores transaction_type 'pin_purchase', which the script never states.
evidence: tool docstring pin_compromised: "'yes_observed': Customer believes PIN was observed/skimmed ... 'unknown': Customer unsure"
user_scenario: "Still have card - I think someone skimmed my card at a gas station or something."
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that maps 'skimmed' to yes_observed, or records signature_purchase for an unspecified in-store charge, fails the exact comparison.
issues.suggested_fix: Script the PIN answer ("I don't know if they got my PIN") and the transaction type.

issues.summary: The script gives the TechWorld discovery date as "today 01/12" while today is 11/14/2025, and the ATM-deposit claim ($500 deposited, $300 credited against a DB credit of $400) is withdrawn only loosely. The gold stores discovery 11/14/2025 and disputed_amount 100.
evidence: user_scenario: "Just discovered today 01/12 during year-end reconciliation."
user_scenario: "If your records show that, then I'll go with what you have."; btxn_0788d2513c8c amount 400.0; get_atm_deposit_images_8473 returns "IMAGES NOT AVAILABLE"
issues.why_it_matters: A careful agent resolves 'today' to 11/14 and confirms $500-$400=$100 with the customer, but a literal or differently confirmed value fails.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the date typo and have the customer state the corrected deposit claim explicitly.

solution_check: Reconstructed: GFF has room for two disputes (Entry max 2), so the third-party ATM $100 and SupplyPro go ahead and the crypto charge waits. Evergreen has one open dispute (Premium max 4), so three more are allowed: incorrect amount $200, TechWorld $625 late fraud with close_and_reissue, and the ATM deposit $100. Then close Evergreen as fraud_suspected and reorder EXPEDITED $0 PREMIUM $0, shipped to the restaurant address, as the best free options for Premium. All of this matches the gold apart from the flagged values.
prior_note: The prior Minor (ATM-deposit amount guided by the script) is now one of several issues; the liability and PIN/transaction-type ambiguities raise the task to Major.
notes: Provisional flags follow the category lists consistently here; the third-party ATM is eligible per doc_033 ("Provisional credit is still required within 10 business days"). Affidavit applies only above $200, so not triggered for the $100 third-party ATM dispute.
